thought.text: Proxy hidup — IP residensial US asli (`69.246.89.118`), berbeda dari IP lokal kita. Sekarang saya cek apakah capbypass punya task Turnstile dengan proxy.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import json,urllib.request
for ep in ["/api/v1/task/types","/getTaskTypes","/taskTypes"]:
    try:
        r=urllib.request.urlopen(urllib.request.Request("https://api.capbypass.pro"+ep,
            data=json.dumps({"clientKey":"cap_live_2a9c30a47d0bbdfde2f4470b61648b0b"}).encode(),
            headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"}),timeout=25)
        d=json.load(r); s=json.dumps(d)
        print(ep,"OK, ada Turnstile:", "Turnstile" in s, "len",len(s))
        import re
        print(sorted(set(re.findall(r'"[A-Za-z]*Turnstile[A-Za-z]*"',s))))
        break
    except Exception as e: print(ep,"->",type(e).__name__,str(e)[:80])
PY
